title: ReplyNeededOutput
description: Structured output of the classify.reply_needed route, prompt v4 (013). Supersedes specs/004-skip-closing-messages/contracts/reply-needed-output.schema.json; tests/contract/test_reply_needed_schema.py points here after 013.

reply_needed.description: True when the user would answer: a question, request or instruction to the user, news that affects the user and calls for a reaction, disagreement, a greeting that opens a conversation, or a user rule that asks to draft this turn.

category.description: What the turn mainly is when it needs no reply; 'informational' when it only shares news, a status, an announcement, a document, a link or reference data and asks nothing; 'none' otherwise.

resolves_pending.description: Only meaningful when pending_draft is true: the turn withdraws the earlier request. False otherwise.

decided_by.description: 'user_rule' when a rule in the user_rules block settled reply_needed (in either direction); 'default' when the built-in rules did.
